what_this_does.description: What changes for someone using or operating this, in plain English, for a product owner who cannot read code. Not a file list. 'This is plumbing and nobody will notice it' is a real and useful answer when it is true.

what_it_does_not_do.description: The limits: what a reasonable person would assume this covers and it does not, what was deferred, what it deliberately refuses. The field David cannot get anywhere else -- never padded with restatements of what it does.

what_you_are_trusting.description: What rests on judgement rather than evidence: untested paths, defects knowingly shipped, findings declined, assumptions the diff makes about its inputs. 'Very little, this is well covered' is a real answer when it is true.

recommendation.description: One line naming what David should do before merging, and what to ask. null when there is nothing -- a real and common answer, never a hole to fill.
